CHECK BURST B1-faces-S — face-crop contact sheets for eye-state labelling (Run C-3 lap 2, idle blink fix, ledger R-C3-29). task_id "B1-faces-S". REPORT ONLY.

Input (read-only): the clip /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/xvideo/in/S_idle.mp4 (768×1168, 24 fps, 145 frames, #00ff00 plate). Frozen tools under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/ (run, never modify): oracle/video_cut.py (split, matte_frames with edge_mode='clamp', track). python glue importing them is fine; no new tool files; PIL + numpy only.

Do exactly: (1) vc.split(clip, out/tmp/native, t_max_s=4.4) → native frames 0…104; vc.matte_frames(paths, edge_mode='clamp'). (2) For each native frame k: head box = the alpha≥128 bounding box of the largest component's top 16 % of its height (the head), expanded to a square around its centre with 25 % margin; crop that square from the MATTED frame composited on #3a3f4a; resize to 128×128 with LANCZOS. Use the SAME per-frame head box method for every frame (no smoothing). (3) Sheets: out/faces_0.png, out/faces_1.png, out/faces_2.png — native frames 0–35, 36–71, 72–104 in a 6-column grid of 128-px cells with a 20-px caption strip under each cell reading the native index (e.g. 'n=37') in white; plain #111 background. (4) out/faces_index.json: {"clip":…, "sheets":[{"file":"faces_0.png","native_indices":[…]},…], "crop_px":128}. Delete out/tmp before returning.
No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 10 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "B1-faces-S"; images []; files: out/faces_0.png, out/faces_1.png, out/faces_2.png, out/faces_index.json with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
